rows.intro: Correction without compromise. Our Targeted Hand Buffing & Polishing service zeroes in on localized imperfections—like paint transfer, dull spots, and minor blemishes—without disturbing the integrity of the surrounding finish. Using carefully selected compounds and manual techniques, we restore clarity and gloss exactly where it’s needed, delivering a seamless blend and a high-quality finish that maintains factory depth.
rows.title: Targeted Hand Buffing & Polishing:
rows.overview:
1. Imperfection Evaluation & Surface Review

  • Inspect scuffs, dull patches, or isolated blemishes to determine severity and location.

  • Confirm paint type and condition (clear coat, single-stage, gel coat) for product compatibility.


2. Surface Cleaning & Prep

  • Clean affected area thoroughly using a wax-stripping wash or panel prep solution.

  • Remove any oils or contaminants to ensure proper compound bonding.


3. Compound & Applicator Selection

  • Choose the lightest effective combination of cutting compound and hand applicator (foam or microfiber).

  • Always start with the least aggressive method and escalate only if needed.


4. Precision Buffing & Correction

  • Apply compound in tight, circular or cross-hatch motions across the affected zone.

  • Gently blend outward to taper correction edges for a uniform look.

  • Wipe away residue and inspect between passes to avoid overworking the area.


5. Gloss Refinement & Optional Sealant

  • Apply a fine polish to restore brilliance and even out the finish.

  • Protect the restored zone with a spray wax, sealant, or coating as recommended.

  • Ensure gloss uniformity with the surrounding paintwork.


6. Final Inspection & Blend Confirmation

  • Use angled lighting or direct sunlight to check for haloing, micro-marring, or buff trails.

  • Invite customer walkaround to confirm satisfaction with restored area.

rows.intro: See clearly. Drive safely. Our Exterior Glass – Rain Repellent Application enhances visibility in rain, snow, and road spray by applying a high-performance hydrophobic treatment to your vehicle’s windshield and windows. This advanced solution bonds with glass to repel moisture, reduce streaking, and prevent water spot buildup—delivering a safer, cleaner view no matter the conditions
rows.title: Window Rain Repellant:
rows.overview:
1. Glass Inspection & Pre-Cleaning

  • Assess all exterior glass for grime buildup, water spots, or bug residue.

  • Rinse or pre-treat heavily soiled areas to loosen contaminants before wiping.


2. Thorough Glass Cleaning

  • Use ammonia-free, tint-safe glass cleaner and microfiber towels to remove oils, streaks, and haze.

  • Dry completely to ensure optimal bonding for the repellent treatment.


3. Rain Repellent Application

  • Apply hydrophobic solution to exterior glass surfaces in small, overlapping sections.

  • Let product haze and bond with the glass surface before buffing.


4. Buffing & Water Behavior Test

  • Use clean microfiber to buff treated surfaces until crystal-clear.

  • Test water beading and repellency by misting with purified water.


5. Final Inspection & Aftercare Tips

  • Verify coating uniformity under angled light and clean edges for streak-free results.

  • Provide maintenance guidance—avoid wiper use on dry glass and use pH-balanced washes to preserve longevity.

rows.intro: Where the road meets refinement. Our Rim & Tire Cleaning service removes stubborn brake dust, road grime, and embedded buildup from your R.V.’s wheels and tires—without compromising their integrity. Using high-quality, surface-safe cleaners and precision tools, we restore a spotless, professional-grade finish that enhances appearance, prolongs component life, and lays the foundation for protection add-ons.
rows.title: Rim & Tire Cleaning/Dressing:
rows.overview:
1. Surface Inspection & Finish Check

  • Examine rims and tires for contamination level, staining, or browning.

  • Identify finish type (painted, polished, chrome, aluminum) to determine safe cleaning methods.


2. Initial Rinse & Dirt Loosening

  • Rinse all wheels and tires to dislodge loose debris.

  • Apply dedicated tire and wheel cleaner with pH-balanced or non-acidic formulas.

  • Let dwell to break down grime and brake dust.


3. Precision Cleaning & Agitation

  • Use stiff brushes for tires and soft-detail brushes for wheels, lugs, and spokes.

  • Gently scrub barrels, edges, and hard-to-reach contours to lift buildup.

  • Rinse thoroughly between stages to prevent sling or product residue.


4. Final Rinse & Surface Check

  • Ensure all product and contamination is removed.

  • Wipe wheel faces and dry tire sidewalls for inspection.


5. Optional Dressing or Sealant Prep

  • Leave wheels and tires clean and dry—or prepare surface for optional polish or dressing application.

  • Recommend upgrades like Heavy Polish or Rim Protection if needed.

rows.intro: Refreshed overhead. Refined throughout. Our Complete Headliner Cleaning service removes embedded dust, stains, and lingering odors from your vehicle’s ceiling using low-moisture, fabric-safe techniques. Designed to preserve the headliner’s integrity and prevent sagging, this deep-cleaning process delivers a spotless, uniform finish—enhancing interior freshness and visual appeal without compromising structure.
rows.title: Complete Headliner Cleaning:
rows.overview:
1. Full Headliner Assessment

  • Inspect for stains, odor pockets, sagging, or adhesive weakening.

  • Identify material type (woven, suede-like, synthetic blend) to confirm safe product usage.


2. Dust & Debris Removal

  • Use soft brushes and air tools to lift surface-level lint, dust, and debris from seams and dome light surrounds.

  • Prep material for safe chemical contact.


3. Low-Moisture Shampoo Application

  • Lightly mist fabric-safe, low-moisture cleaner onto microfiber towel or applicator.

  • Avoid direct spraying to protect adhesive and foam layers.


4. Controlled Agitation & Spot Lifting

  • Gently agitate target zones using a pat-and-blot method or soft upholstery brush.

  • Spot treat staining with localized enzyme or degreaser as needed.

  • Refrain from saturation or deep kneading to prevent damage.


5. Drying Phase & Panel Uniformity

  • Allow fabric to air dry with ventilation or mild air flow.

  • Inspect for visible rings, texture inconsistencies, or remaining discoloration.


6. Final Walkthrough & Aftercare Notes

  • Review visual and tactile results with client.

  • Offer guidance on headliner preservation and products to avoid (ammonia, over-wetting cleaners).

rows.intro: Eliminate contamination. Ensure cabin health. Our Mold Removal Service targets active mold growth within your vehicle’s interior using advanced cleaners and strategic remediation protocols. This process neutralizes visible and invisible spores, restores affected materials, and prevents re-growth—protecting both surfaces and air quality for a safer, healthier driving environment.
rows.title: Interior Mold & Mildew Removal:
rows.overview:
1. Contamination Assessment & Source Identification

  • Inspect interior surfaces, HVAC outlets, and moisture-prone zones for mold presence and spread.

  • Identify underlying causes—water intrusion, condensation, or high humidity exposure.


2. Pre-Treatment & Personal Protective Prep

  • Ventilate work area and isolate affected zones.

  • Use gloves, respirators, and mold-safe containment when required.


3. Targeted Surface Cleaning & Spore Neutralization

  • Apply EPA-approved mold remediation solutions to affected fabrics, plastics, or paneling.

  • Agitate and lift mold colonies using soft tools, steam, or scrubbing pads.

  • Extract loosened contaminants using microfiber or wet vac system.


4. HVAC Duct & System Sanitization (If Needed)

  • Introduce ozone treatment or HVAC-safe sanitizer into air system to prevent airborne redistribution.

  • Run blower cycle to ensure deep duct contact and full system coverage.


5. Dry-Out & Dehumidification Phase

  • Use air movers or dehumidifiers to rapidly reduce cabin humidity.

  • Test for residual moisture before reassembly or follow-up treatment.


6. Final Inspection & Prevention Recommendations

  • Evaluate restored zones for recurrence risk.

  • Recommend sealing, weatherstrip replacement, or preventative reapplication as needed.

rows.intro: Classic brilliance. Handcrafted protection. Our Carnauba Blend Paste Wax Application delivers a deep, warm gloss and lasting surface defense—all without machine intervention. Hand-applied with care, this premium wax treatment uses a refined blend of natural carnauba and advanced polymers to enrich your paint’s clarity, smoothness, and water repellency. Ideal for clients who appreciate detail by touch and shine by tradition.
rows.title: Carnauba Paste Wax Application:
rows.overview:
1. Surface Prep Confirmation

  • Verify the vehicle has been properly washed and decontaminated via clay bar and iron removal.

  • Inspect for remaining contaminants or swirl marks before sealing in the surface.


2. Wax Selection & Applicator Prep

  • Choose premium carnauba-blend paste wax suited to paint type and finish goals.

  • Load product onto foam or microfiber applicator for even distribution.


3. Hand Application (Panel by Panel)

  • Apply wax in tight, overlapping circular or straight-line patterns across 1–2 panels at a time.

  • Allow proper curing time for bonding and hazing before removal.


4. Buffing & Layer Refinement

  • Use fresh microfiber towels to gently remove wax haze and reveal gloss.

  • Buff to high clarity while monitoring for uniform glow and dry-touch finish.


5. Final Panel Check & Optional Second Layer

  • Perform side-angle inspection under natural or LED light.

  • Apply second coat for added depth and longevity if desired.


6. Client Review & Aftercare Tips

  • Highlight gloss improvement, smoothness, and feel of the paint.

  • Recommend reapplication timelines and wash techniques to preserve results.

raw_wix_data.Title: Carnauba Paste Wax Application:
raw_wix_data.Overview:

  • Verify the vehicle has been properly washed and decontaminated via clay bar and iron removal.

  • Inspect for remaining contaminants or swirl marks before sealing in the surface.


2. Wax Selection & Applicator Prep

  • Choose premium carnauba-blend paste wax suited to paint type and finish goals.

  • Load product onto foam or microfiber applicator for even distribution.


3. Hand Application (Panel by Panel)

  • Apply wax in tight, overlapping circular or straight-line patterns across 1–2 panels at a time.

  • Allow proper curing time for bonding and hazing before removal.


4. Buffing & Layer Refinement

  • Use fresh microfiber towels to gently remove wax haze and reveal gloss.

  • Buff to high clarity while monitoring for uniform glow and dry-touch finish.


5. Final Panel Check & Optional Second Layer

  • Perform side-angle inspection under natural or LED light.

  • Apply second coat for added depth and longevity if desired.


6. Client Review & Aftercare Tips

  • Highlight gloss improvement, smoothness, and feel of the paint.

  • Recommend reapplication timelines and wash techniques to preserve results.

Our Seats & Carpets – Spot Shampooed (Touch-Up) service targets isolated stains, light spills, and localized discoloration without the need for a full interior extraction. Using fabric-safe, professional-grade cleaners and focused treatment techniques, we lift blemishes from high-visibility zones to restore cleanliness, uniformity, and comfort to your cabin space.
rows.title: Seats/Carpets - Spot Shampooed:
rows.notice: Spot shampoo is not a complete interior shampoo. It includes up to 3 softball size spots. Upgrade to Premium for complete shampoo.
rows.overview:
1. Inspection & Stain Identification

  • Walk through cabin to identify high-impact spill zones, visible stains, or high-friction discoloration.

  • Assess upholstery material (fabric, microfiber, blended fibers) and stain type for proper chemical selection.


2. Vacuuming & Debris Removal

  • Light vacuum around affected areas to remove surface dirt and debris.

  • Expose stain fully for direct chemical application and effective penetration.


3. Spot Treatment Application

  • Apply upholstery-safe stain remover or enzyme cleaner directly to target areas.

  • Allow proper dwell time based on product and soil type.


4. Agitation & Hand Extraction

  • Gently agitate with upholstery brush or microfiber to loosen embedded grime.

  • Blot and extract moisture using absorbent towels or compact upholstery extractor.


5. Final Touch-Up & Uniformity Check

  • Blend cleaned zone with surrounding surface to minimize rings or transitions.

  • Re-treat as needed for stubborn marks or odor concerns.


6. Drying & Customer Walkthrough

  • Allow surfaces to air dry or speed-dry with airflow if required.

  • Review results with customer and offer recommendations for full shampooing if needed in future.

rows.intro: Luxury that lasts. Our Leather Deep Clean & Conditioning service removes embedded oils, sweat, and grime while restoring softness, color depth, and durability. Using pH-balanced, professional-grade cleaners and hydrating conditioners, we refresh worn or neglected leather surfaces—preventing cracking, fading, and premature wear while leaving a rich, supple finish that looks and feels refined.
rows.title: Leather Deep Clean & Conditioning:
rows.overview:
1. Leather Condition Assessment

  • Inspect seats, headrests, bolsters, and armrests for wear, cracking, discoloration, or buildup.

  • Confirm leather type (coated, perforated, aniline) to ensure safe product selection.


2. Pre-Cleaning & Dust Removal

  • Gently vacuum and dust all seams, stitching, and panel gaps.

  • Use soft brushes or compressed air to prep tight zones.


3. Deep Cleaning Application

  • Apply leather-safe cleaner with foam applicator or brush.

  • Agitate surface to lift dirt and body oils without oversaturation.

  • Wipe away residue with microfiber towel after dwell and emulsification.


4. Conditioning Treatment

  • Apply conditioner or leather balm evenly across panels, allowing product to absorb.

  • Buff gently for matte or satin finish based on OEM tone.

  • Repeat for dried or porous areas requiring extra hydration.


5. Final Inspection & Touch-Up

  • Inspect for uniform tone, texture, and non-greasy feel.

  • Spot-treat blemishes or dry zones as needed.

  • Recommend regular touch-ups for high-contact zones like driver seats and armrests.

rows.intro: Deep clean. Fresh feel. Our Complete Interior Shampoo service delivers a full-fabric reset, targeting embedded stains, odors, and grime across all seats, carpets, and upholstery. Using professional-grade extraction and shampooing methods, we lift contaminants from deep within the fibers—restoring comfort, eliminating allergens, and leaving your cabin clean, refreshed, and ready to breathe.
rows.title: Complete Interior Shampoo:
rows.overview:
1. Interior Assessment & Material Identification

  • Inspect seats, carpets, and headliners for staining, wear, or odors.

  • Confirm fabric type to select compatible cleaners and extraction method.


2. Surface Vacuuming & Debris Prep

  • Thoroughly vacuum all upholstery and carpeted zones, including under and between seats.

  • Remove surface debris to prepare for maximum shampoo absorption.


3. Pre-Treatment of High-Soil Areas

  • Apply enzymatic or degreasing pre-spray to heavy-use areas and visible stains.

  • Allow dwell time for breakdown of organic soils and embedded grime.


4. Shampoo Application & Agitation

  • Apply fabric-safe shampoo using low-moisture sprayer or foam applicator.

  • Agitate with upholstery brushes or soft scrub pads to loosen embedded dirt.

  • Apply pressurized water to lift deep dirt, sand, grime, shampoo, and detergants


5. Extraction & Moisture Removal

  • Perform water extraction or low-moisture rinse depending on fabric type.

  • Remove shampoo, residue, and contaminants with controlled passes.


6. Drying & Ventilation

  • Allow fabric to air-dry or use airflow/heat system to speed dry-time.

  • Leave cabin ventilated and damp zones open when possible.


7. Final Inspection & Post-Treatment Review

  • Spot-check all zones for uniformity.

  • Recommend interior protectants or odor control treatments if desired.

  • Invite customer walkthrough and care recommendations.

rows.intro: Clean from cabin to cargo. Our Full Interior & Trunk Vacuuming service targets hidden dust, dirt, pet hair, and debris throughout your vehicle’s passenger and storage areas. Using commercial-grade vacuums and precision nozzles, we reach deep into footwells, under seats, between cushions, and through every corner of the trunk—delivering a refreshed, debris-free interior ready for protection or conditioning.
rows.title: Full Interior & Trunk Vacuuming:
rows.overview:
1. Interior Walkthrough & Loose Debris Removal

  • Remove personal items, mats, and trunk cargo.

  • Inspect seats, floors, and crevices for buildup and vacuum intensity needs.


2. Floor Mats & Trunk Panels

  • Vacuum floor mats thoroughly, lifting grit from fibers and backing.

  • Address trunk side panels, spare tire wells, and storage bins.


3. Cabin Footwells & Underseat Zones

  • Vacuum front and rear footwells using crevice and brush tools.

  • Reach beneath seats and around rails for concealed debris and crumbs.


4. Seat Surfaces & Cushion Seams

  • Vacuum cloth, leather, or vinyl seats with appropriate nozzles.

  • Pay attention to seams, stitching, and between-cushion spaces.


5. Dash & Console Perimeter

  • Use soft brush attachments to lift dust along trim edges and around console bases.

  • Avoid direct vacuum contact with sensitive electronics or buttons.


6. Final Crevice Check & Lint Control

  • Revisit tight areas—door pockets, seat tracks, and trunk corners—for missed debris.

  • Use compressed air or mini tools for lint-heavy zones if needed.


7. Customer Review or Interior Add-On Discussion

  • Offer overview of cleanliness level achieved.

  • Recommend interior shampooing, steam cleaning, or leather conditioning based on inspection.

rows.intro: Details at every opening. Our Door Jamb Cleaning service clears away the dirt, grease, and grime that collects in the seams and thresholds around your doors—areas that often go ignored but speak volumes about overall cleanliness. Using professional-grade cleaners and targeted tools, we lift buildup from hinges, sills, and seals, restoring a crisp, polished look that complements a fully detailed finish.
rows.title: Door Jam Cleaning:
rows.overview:
1. Jam Condition Review & Panel Mapping

  • Inspect all door jambs—including front, rear, trunk, and hatch—for buildup, grease lines, and hidden debris.

  • Evaluate weather seals, paint lip edges, and hardware exposure.


2. Initial Cleaning & Degreasing

  • Apply mild degreaser or APC (all-purpose cleaner) to surfaces and crevices.

  • Use soft detailing brushes to agitate grime around latches, strikers, and hinges.

  • Wipe away residue and reapply as needed to cut through stubborn buildup.


3. Panel Seams & Weather Stripping

  • Carefully clean rubber  weather seals and painted seams with microfiber-tipped tools.

  • Avoid over-saturation and inspect for trapped contaminants or fading.


4. Final Wipe & Dry Touch Finish

  • Rinse or neutralize product residue where needed, then dry with clean microfiber towels.

  • Restore sheen to painted edges or apply protectant to rubber seals if part of an enhancement package.


5. Customer Walkthrough or Add-On Pairing

  • Showcase the refreshed appearance and highlight areas often missed in standard washes.

  • Offer pairing with Exterior Hand Wash or Trim Dressing for seamless presentation.

Using professional-grade cleaners and targeted tools, we lift buildup from hinges, sills, and seals, restoring a crisp, polished look that complements a fully detailed finish.
raw_wix_data.Title: Door Jam Cleaning:
raw_wix_data.Overview:
1. Jam Condition Review & Panel Mapping

  • Inspect all door jambs—including front, rear, trunk, and hatch—for buildup, grease lines, and hidden debris.

  • Evaluate weather seals, paint lip edges, and hardware exposure.


2. Initial Cleaning & Degreasing

  • Apply mild degreaser or APC (all-purpose cleaner) to surfaces and crevices.

  • Use soft detailing brushes to agitate grime around latches, strikers, and hinges.

  • Wipe away residue and reapply as needed to cut through stubborn buildup.


3. Panel Seams & Weather Stripping

  • Carefully clean rubber  weather seals and painted seams with microfiber-tipped tools.

  • Avoid over-saturation and inspect for trapped contaminants or fading.


4. Final Wipe & Dry Touch Finish

  • Rinse or neutralize product residue where needed, then dry with clean microfiber towels.

  • Restore sheen to painted edges or apply protectant to rubber seals if part of an enhancement package.


5. Customer Walkthrough or Add-On Pairing

  • Showcase the refreshed appearance and highlight areas often missed in standard washes.

  • Offer pairing with Exterior Hand Wash or Trim Dressing for seamless presentation.

rows.intro: Polished to perfection. Our Chrome Machine Polishing service restores brilliance to weathered or dulled chrome by removing oxidation, mineral deposits, and fine surface imperfections. Using rotary or dual-action machines with metal-safe compounds, we deliver a mirror-like finish without compromising the surface—enhancing shine, depth, and reflectivity with precision detailing you can see.
rows.title: Chrome Machine Polishing:
rows.overview:
1. Chrome Surface Evaluation

  • Inspect bumpers, trim, hardware, and accents for oxidation, etching, or spotting.

  • Confirm that chrome is genuine or plated (not polished aluminum) to select safe product combinations.


2. Cleaning & Decontamination

  • Wash chrome surfaces thoroughly to remove loose dirt, road film, and wax residue.

  • Apply iron remover or degreaser where needed to dissolve contaminants and ensure clean prep.


3. Machine Polish Setup & Testing

  • Select chrome-safe polish and appropriate buffing pad (foam or wool).

  • Perform a spot test in a discreet area to evaluate finish compatibility and gloss response.


4. Precision Machine Polishing

  • Use rotary or dual-action polisher at controlled speed and pressure.

  • Work in small zones with overlapping passes, leveling imperfections without overheating or overworking.

  • Wipe away residue after each section for clarity checks.


5. Final Buff & Sealant Application (Optional)

  • Final buff with soft microfiber to enhance depth and remove haze.

  • Optionally apply a metal sealant or wax to help maintain brilliance and add a hydrophobic barrier.


6. Final Light Inspection & Customer Review

  • Evaluate results under angled lighting to confirm uniformity and clarity.

  • Invite client walkaround and offer maintenance recommendations for long-term preservation.

rows.intro: Preserve the clean. Protect the comfort. Our Stain Protection Application service applies a durable, invisible barrier to interior fabrics—including carpets, cloth seats, and upholstery—to help repel liquids, resist staining, and prevent premature wear. Using advanced fabric protection technology, this treatment guards your interior without altering its texture, breathability, or color—making ongoing maintenance simpler and surfaces longer-lasting.
rows.title: 2 Year Cloth & Carpet Stain Repellant
rows.overview:
1. Surface Eligibility Check

  • Confirm fabric type (cloth, synthetic blend, Alcantara) is compatible with protection treatment.

  • Ensure interior has been cleaned via vacuuming, shampooing, or steam extraction before application.

2. Dry Surface Prep

  • Allow all fabric areas to fully dry to promote optimal bonding.

  • Perform lint roll or air pass to remove residual dust and fiber debris.

3. Application of Fabric Protector

  • Apply hydrophobic, fiber-safe protectant in controlled mist across targeted zones.

  • Focus on high-traffic areas: seats, bolsters, rear footwells, cargo carpet.

4. Even Spread & Bonding Pass

  • Gently brush or pad in product to ensure even coverage and fiber penetration.

  • Allow product to cure per manufacturer dwell times (typically 2–4 hours before contact).

5. Drying Phase & Visual Finish Check

  • Verify matte, residue-free finish across all panels.

  • Reapply to vulnerable zones or double-layer if added defense is requested.

6. Final Review & Customer Education

  • Demonstrate water-beading effect or dry-time guidelines.

  • Offer aftercare suggestions for spills, vacuuming, and reapplication frequency.

rows.intro: Deep clean. Subtle sheen. Our Vinyl, Plastics, & Button Shining service provides a thorough interior reset by removing heavy grime, oils, and buildup from all interior surfaces—followed by the application of a dry-touch protectant for a clean, satin finish. Covering dashboards, door panels, consoles, cup holders, visors, and seat plastics, we restore texture, tone, and depth without leaving behind greasy residue.
rows.title: Vinyl, Plastics, & Button Shining:
rows.overview:
1. Interior Assessment & Material Review

  • Identify zones with heavy buildup, smudges, or neglected surfaces.

  • Confirm plastic type and trim finish to select safe products and sheen level.


2. Heavy Debris Removal & Pre-Cleaning

  • Blow out dust and grit using compressed air and soft brushes.

  • Vacuum edges and seams for detail prep.


3. Deep-Clean Application & Agitation

  • Apply interior-safe degreaser or heavy-duty APC to high-contact areas.

  • Use foam-tipped swabs, brushes, and microfiber to agitate grime around buttons, knobs, and seams.

  • Detail cup holders, shifters, armrests, and steering wheel fascia.


4. Dressing Application & Finish Control

  • Apply satin or matte interior dressing to clean, dry surfaces.

  • Buff and blend for uniform texture and tone based on client’s gloss preference.


5. Final Inspection & Touchpoint Review

  • Check all treated areas under natural or LED light for streaks or missed debris.

  • Revisit high-use zones for consistency. Offer care tips for dust prevention and maintainability.

rows.intro: Long-lasting protection. Showroom-level shine. Our 2–3 Year Ceramic Coating service is engineered to chemically bond with your vehicle’s clear coat, forming a durable, hydrophobic barrier that resists UV rays, chemical fallout, road grime, and oxidation. Infused with advanced nano-ceramic technology, this treatment enhances gloss, simplifies cleaning, and defends against harsh environments—backed by a 2-year warranty for total peace of mind.
rows.title: 2-3 Year Ceramic Coating:
rows.overview:
1. Surface Evaluation & Paint Prep Planning

  • Inspect the vehicle’s clear coat for oxidation, swirl marks, or contaminants.

  • Identify prep steps needed—such as iron removal, clay bar treatment, or paint correction—for ideal bonding.


2. Deep Decontamination & Prep

  • Perform a thorough hand wash and rinse.

  • Apply iron remover and use a nano clay bar to eliminate bonded particles.

  • Dry and wipe with a panel prep solution to strip oils and residues.


3. Paint Correction (Add-On, If Needed)

  • Conduct targeted or multi-stage polishing to remove defects and restore gloss.

  • Wipe down corrected surfaces to ensure a bare, high-clarity finish.


4. Ceramic Coating Application

  • Apply nano-ceramic coating in small, controlled sections using suede applicators.

  • Allow coating to flash, then level and buff for a consistent gloss.

  • Continue across all painted panels, including trim and high-exposure zones.


5. Cure Time & Protection Guidelines

  • Allow coating to cure for 12–24 hours, avoiding moisture or hand contact.

  • Full chemical resistance typically develops within 5–7 days.


6. Final Inspection & Warranty Activation

  • Review finish under natural light to confirm uniform gloss and repellency.

  • Provide aftercare instructions and activate 2-year warranty coverage.

rows.intro: Clean where it counts. Our Engine Bay Cleaning & Detailing service removes grease, grime, and environmental buildup from your vehicle’s engine compartment using safe, controlled methods. Designed to restore a well-maintained appearance without risking electrical or sensitive components, this treatment enhances cleanliness, reduces long-term wear, and adds visual pride every time the hood lifts.
rows.title: Engine Bay Cleaning & Detailing:
rows.overview:
1. Engine Assessment & Safety Prep

  • Inspect the engine bay for buildup, oil residue, corrosion, and exposed wiring or sensors.

  • Cover vulnerable components (air intakes, fuse boxes, alternators, batteries) with plastic or specialized wraps.


2. Dry Debris Removal

  • Use compressed air and soft brushes to clear leaves, dust, and loose particles from crevices and surfaces.

  • Target corners, reservoirs, mounts, and under-hood panels.


3. Degreasing & Controlled Cleaning

  • Apply non-acidic, engine-safe degreaser to affected areas.

  • Agitate gently with soft detailing brushes to lift dirt and oil without overspray or runoff risk.

  • Wipe down or perform light rinse, depending on vehicle and condition.


4. Drying & Finish Buffing

  • Use microfiber towels and compressed air to remove moisture and product residue.

  • Ensure dry-touch finish on all surfaces, including caps, plastics, and painted areas.


5. Plastic & Rubber Dressing (Optional)

  • Apply trim-safe conditioner to restore vibrancy on plastic covers, hoses, and weather seals.

  • Leave dry-to-touch, non-greasy finish.


6. Final Inspection & Function Check

  • Remove all protective wraps.

  • Check that no moisture or product remains near critical connectors.

  • Invite customer review and offer care tips for post-service maintenance.

rows.intro: Clarity that completes the detail. rows.title: Exterior Glass Cleaning:
rows.overview:

  • Mist glass with high-quality, tint-safe cleaner.

  • Focus on windshields, side windows, mirrors, and sunroofs—one section at a time for precision.


3. Dual-Towel Wipe Down

  • Wipe using straight-line motions with a clean, damp microfiber towel to lift residue.

  • Follow immediately with a dry towel to polish to a crystal-clear finish.

  • Detail around window seals, trim edges, and mirror contours to remove buildup.

  • Use soft brushes or swabs to catch tight or recessed areas if needed.

  • Inspect glass under natural light or LED to catch streaks or haze.

  • Rebuff any sections to ensure flawless results.


6. Optional Add-On Pairing

  • Recommend Rain Repellent Application or full Visibility Enhancement Bundle for next-level clarity and weather resistance.

Our Carnauba Blend Spray Wax Application enhances your vehicle’s appearance with a deep, mirror-like glow while shielding it from environmental damage. rows.title: Carnauba Wax Application:
rows.overview:
1. Surface Inspection & Prep Confirmation

  • Confirm exterior is freshly washed, clean, and cool to the touch.

  • Inspect for tar, sap, or water spots that may inhibit wax performance.


2. Surface Drying

  • Dry the entire exterior with microfiber towels or air blowers.

  • Check for lingering moisture around emblems, trim, and panel edges.


3. Spray Wax Application

  • Mist carnauba blend spray wax onto a single panel at a time.

  • Spread evenly using a clean microfiber towel in overlapping patterns.


4. Buffing & Gloss Enhancement

  • Buff with a second microfiber towel to reveal a glossy, streak-free finish.

  • Work in natural light when possible to confirm clarity and consistency.


5. Panel-by-Panel Coverage

  • Continue application and buffing across all exterior painted surfaces, including slide-outs and high-exposure zones.


6. Final Walkaround & Clarity Check

  • Inspect finish from multiple angles to ensure uniform gloss.

  • Recommend complementary services like Rain Repellent or Trim Dressing for total surface harmony.

rows.intro: Clear inside, confident outside. Our Interior Window Cleaning service eliminates dust, smudges, and fingerprints from all interior glass surfaces using streak-free cleaners and precision methods. From windshields and side windows to rear glass and sunroofs, we restore sharp visibility and a spotless, glare-free finish—enhancing both your driving experience and your vehicle’s interior presentation.
rows.title: Interior Window Cleaning:
rows.overview:
1. Glass Condition Inspection

  • Review interior glass for smudges, haze, film buildup, and dust accumulation.

  • Focus on high-touch areas including windshields, side glass, and sliding windows.


2. Surface Prepping & Initial Dust-Off

  • Use microfiber towels or soft brushes to remove loose particles along edges, dash seams, and headliner trims.

  • Check for foggy buildup from interior off-gassing or climate control residue.


3. Streak-Free Glass Cleaner Application

  • Spray ammonia-free, tint-safe cleaner onto one section at a time to prevent oversaturation.

  • Target edges, corners, and curved zones to ensure full coverage.


4. Precision Wipe Down

  • Use a two-towel method: one for application, one for final buff-out.

  • Follow straight-line motions across windshields and horizontal passes for side glass to detect streaks.


5. Mirror, Sunroof & Visor Coverage

  • Clean rearview mirrors, sunroof glass, and vanity visor mirrors with smaller applicators for full interior clarity.


6. Final Inspection & Lighting Check

  • Inspect glass from both inside and outside under directional light to confirm streak-free results.

  • Re-polish if necessary to remove haze or microfiber lint.

rows.intro: Precision in every touchpoint. Our Vinyl, Plastics, & Button Wipe Down service removes dust, oils, fingerprints, and light buildup from high-contact interior surfaces—restoring clarity, color, and texture. Using safe, material-specific cleaners and soft-touch techniques, we detail everything from dashboards and door panels to seat trim and control buttons—delivering a uniform, refreshed interior without streaks, fading, or product residue.
rows.title: Vinyl, Plastics, & Button Wipe Down:
rows.overview:
1. Interior Inspection & Touchpoint Mapping

  • Assess dashboard, console, door cards, visors, seatbacks, switches, and infotainment bezels for buildup.

  • Identify material types (textured vinyl, soft plastics, piano black trim) to choose proper cleaner strength.


2. Dusting & Pre-Wipe Prep

  • Use soft brushes and air to lift loose dust from seams, vents, and control faces.

  • Target button edges, badge inlays, and textured grains for trapped debris.


3. Cleaner Application & Wipe Down

  • Apply vinyl/plastic-safe interior cleaner using microfiber towels or detailing swabs.

  • Wipe with straight or light circular motions, ensuring full panel coverage and minimal oversaturation.


4. Button & Detail Zone Cleaning

  • Gently clean control switches, knobs, and button surfaces with foam-tip applicators or interior brushes.

  • Avoid pressure on infotainment or digital display borders.


5. Final Buff & Finish Check

  • Buff all treated areas with a dry microfiber to remove product residue and prevent streaking.

  • Inspect under natural or soft lighting for uniform luster and clarity.

rows.intro: Precision smoothness. Lasting clarity. Our Nano Clay Bar Decontamination service targets embedded contaminants like industrial fallout, rail dust, overspray, and road grime—bonded particles that traditional washing can’t remove. Using ultra-fine, nano-grade clay media, we safely lift impurities from the clear coat without harming the surface. The result: a buttery-smooth, glass-like finish that’s fully prepped for waxes, sealants, or ceramic coatings.
rows.title: Nano Clay Bar Decontamination:
rows.overview:
1. Surface Inspection & Contaminant Check

  • Examine paint texture and visual clarity for signs of bonded contaminants, spotting, or paint roughness.

  • Use glove test or plastic bag method to confirm particle presence across high-impact areas.


2. Thorough Exterior Wash & Rinse

  • Perform a hand wash using the two-bucket method to remove surface dirt and loose debris.

  • Dry surface or leave slightly damp to assist clay lubrication.


3. Clay Lubricant Application

  • Spray dedicated clay lubricant or clay-safe detail spray on a small section at a time.

  • Maintain consistent lubrication to minimize drag and surface marring.


4. Nano Clay Bar Pass

  • Glide clay bar or synthetic media in straight-line motions with light pressure.

  • Focus on panel by panel decontamination—especially hood, roof, doors, bumpers.

  • Knead and fold clay frequently to expose clean surfaces.


5. Residue Removal & Surface Drying

  • Wipe each section with microfiber after claying to remove lifted contaminants and lubricant residue.

  • Inspect by touch and light reflection for smoothness and finish.


6. Protection Readiness & Client Consultation

  • Recommend follow-up wax, sealant, or ceramic coating based on customer protection goals.

  • Offer package upgrades or corrections if surface flaws are revealed during the process.

rows.intro: Stop mold before it starts. Our Mold & Mildew Prevention Treatment applies a transparent, fabric-safe barrier across moisture-prone surfaces to inhibit spore settlement and microbial growth. This preventative treatment deters musty odors and organic buildup by reducing moisture absorption—ideal after a deep clean or odor neutralization. Designed to maintain a hygienic cabin environment while preserving material breathability and integrity.
rows.title: Interior Mold & Mildew Prevention:
rows.overview:
1. Interior Assessment & Prep Confirmation

  • Ensure vehicle has undergone odor removal, extraction, or steam cleaning prior to barrier application.

  • Focus on HVAC zones, seat bases, footwells, trunk carpet, and under-mat areas for vulnerability.


2. Surface Dry-Down & Moisture Control

  • Confirm all treated zones are dry to the touch.

  • Use airflow tools or fans if necessary to accelerate drying in dense fabrics.


3. Application of Mold Inhibitor

  • Apply professional-grade, non-toxic antimicrobial treatment using controlled mist.

rows.intro: Shine that turns heads. Our Exterior Chrome Polishing service revives dull, spotted, or weathered chrome by removing contaminants like oxidation, mineral deposits, and grime. With meticulous hand-finishing techniques and metal-safe polishes, we restore mirror-like brilliance and preserve the integrity of your R.V.’s chrome trim, badges, and hardware—delivering a spotless, high-impact finish that reflects excellence.
rows.title: Chrome Hand Polishing:
rows.overview:
1. Chrome Condition Assessment

  • Inspect chrome surfaces (grilles, trim, badges, hardware) for water spots, oxidation, pitting, or buildup.

  • Identify whether surfaces are OEM, plated, or aftermarket for proper product selection.


2. Cleaning & Prep

  • Wash and dry chrome components thoroughly to remove loose contaminants.

  • Use a pH-safe degreaser or bug remover as needed to break down stubborn surface debris.


3. Polish Selection & Spot Testing

  • Choose a chrome-safe, non-abrasive metal polish.

  • Perform a test pass in an inconspicuous area to confirm clarity response and safety.


4. Precision Hand-Polishing

  • Apply polish using foam applicators or microfiber pads in small, overlapping motions.

  • Work the product until oxidation lifts and shine begins to return.

  • Reapply to stubborn spots as needed.


5. Buff & Detail Refinement

  • Remove polish residue with a soft microfiber towel.

  • Inspect finish for consistency across curved, recessed, and horizontal trim zones.


6. Optional Chrome Sealant or Protection

  • Apply a metal sealant or wax to maintain shine and protect from future spotting or oxidation.

  • Buff to enhance reflectivity and add hydrophobic finish.


7. Final Light Check & Client Review

  • Confirm brilliance under direct light for uniformity.

  • Walk client through results and offer maintenance guidance to retain polish longevity.

rows.intro: Neutralized at the source. Our Odor Removal service uses advanced ozone technology to eliminate embedded smells from your vehicle’s cabin—tackling smoke, mildew, pet odors, and other persistent contaminants at the molecular level. This high-efficiency process doesn’t mask odor—it removes it—leaving your interior fresh, sanitized, and gently scented with a clean, final fragrance.
rows.title: Odor Removal:
rows.overview:
1. Interior Inspection & Pre-Treatment Evaluation

  • Assess cabin for source-specific odor intensity (e.g. smoke, pet residue, mildew).

  • Inspect upholstery, carpet, and HVAC zones for contamination points.


2. Deep Cleaning Prerequisite (If Required)

  • Recommend full vacuuming, spot shampoo, or interior wipe down prior to treatment.

  • Remove odor sources (e.g. pet hair, trash, food residue) for maximum ozone penetration.


3. Vehicle Prep & Seal

  • Close vents, secure cabin, and temporarily disable recirculation where necessary.

  • Run fan system (AC or heat) to circulate ozone through ducts if HVAC odor is present.


4. Ozonator Deployment

  • Place ozone generator in central cabin zone.

  • Activate for 15–60 minutes depending on interior size and odor severity.

  • Ensure unoccupied vehicle and external ventilation post-treatment.


5. Fragrance Application & Purge Cycle

  • After safe ozone dissipation, apply light cabin fragrance upon client request.

  • Air out vehicle and wipe high-contact zones to complete process.


6. Final Review & Aftercare Guidance

  • Walk client through expected scent neutrality timeline.

  • Offer maintenance options or repeat treatment recommendation for extreme cases.

rows.intro: Two expert treatments. One immaculate result. Our Hand Wash, Rinse & Bug Removal service pairs the precision of the two-bucket hand wash method with advanced bug breakdown techniques to refresh your R.V.’s exterior. Designed to preserve the finish and minimize swirl marks, this dual process lifts dirt, grime, and stubborn insect residue—delivering a spotless appearance and setting the stage for enhanced protection.
rows.title: Hand Wash, Rinse, & Bug Removal:
rows.overview:
1. Exterior Rinse & Bug Pre-Soak

  • Rinse entire vehicle to loosen surface dirt and contaminants.

  • Apply bug remover or citrus-based cleaner to bug-heavy zones—grille, front cap, mirrors, windshield—and allow dwell time to break down residue.


2. Two-Bucket Hand Wash Method

  • Use one bucket with soap solution, one with clean water for mitt rinsing between panels.

  • Wash in straight-line motions from top to bottom using a clean microfiber mitt to reduce swirl risks.

  • Focus on panels, doors, bumpers, and high-traffic zones.


3. Targeted Bug Agitation & Removal

  • Gently scrub pre-soaked bug areas with bug sponge or mesh-safe pad.

  • Reapply remover or allow extended dwell time if insects persist.

  • Avoid high-pressure blasting to maintain finish integrity.


4. Rinse & Water Control Check

  • Rinse vehicle thoroughly to remove all soap, bug cleaner, and grime.

  • Inspect for leftover contaminants or water traps in mirror housings, badges, or panel gaps.


5. Drying Phase

  • Use clean microfiber towels or air blower to remove water without spotting.

  • Address crevices, trim, and seams for drip control.


6. Final Inspection & Optional Add-On Discussion

  • Confirm exterior clarity and uniform cleanliness under natural light.

  • Recommend wax, sealant, or ceramic coating add-ons as appropriate for next-step surface protection.

rows.intro: One pass. Total transformation. Our Single-Stage Machine Polishing service rejuvenates tired, dull paint by correcting faint scratches, dulling, and light blemishes in a single, refined polishing step. Combining localized hand buffing with precision machine correction, we remove scuffing, paint transfer, and haze—restoring deep gloss and uniform clarity without the need for multi-stage refinement.
rows.title: Single-Stage Machine Polishing:
rows.overview:
1. Surface Evaluation & Correction Planning

  • Inspect paintwork for light marring and scratches, dullness, or transfer marks.

  • Determine clear coat thickness, paint type, and prior correction history.


2. Wash & Decontamination Prep

  • Conduct a full hand wash and nano clay bar treatment to ensure a clean surface.

  • Apply iron remover as needed to eliminate embedded particles.

  • Dry vehicle and wipe with panel prep to strip surface oils.


3. Targeted Hand Buffing (Pre-Treatment)

  • Use cutting compound and foam or microfiber pad to hand-correct isolated defects (e.g. paint transfer, corner scuffs, mirror backs).

  • Level down surface inconsistencies before full-machine work begins.


4. Machine Polish — Single-Stage Correction Pass

  • Select a polish-compound hybrid and matched foam pad for moderate cut with excellent finish.

  • Polish each panel in overlapping passes using dual-action or rotary tool.

  • Monitor paint temperature, pad rotation, and product breakdown for optimum clarity.


5. Residue Removal & Gloss Check

  • Wipe all panels with clean microfiber to remove compound residue.

  • Inspect under natural or LED light for uniform gloss and defect reduction.


6. Sealant or Coating Prep (Optional)

  • Wipe with panel prep for protection step readiness.

  • Recommend ceramic coating or wax application to lock in clarity.


7. Final Walkthrough & Client Education

  • Review gloss improvement and before/after correction zones with client.

  • Provide care guidelines to maintain finish longevity and avoid re-introducing defects.

rows.intro: Clarity you can count on. Our Headlight Restoration service reverses oxidation, haze, and yellowing caused by UV exposure, road debris, and age. Through a progressive 3-stage wet sanding and compound polishing process, we remove surface damage and restore crystal-clear lenses—dramatically improving night visibility and delivering a refreshed, like-new front-end appearance.
rows.title: Headlight Restoration:
rows.overview:
1. Lens Condition Assessment

  • Inspect for oxidation, pitting, yellowing, and surface dullness.

  • Assess lens material and previous coating condition.


2. Tape Off Surrounding Panels

  • Mask adjacent paint and trim to protect from sanding or compound contact.

  • Clean lenses of surface grime or wax buildup.


3. Wet Sanding: 3-Stage Abrasion

  • Sand using 800 grit to remove top-level oxidation and deep haze.

  • Follow with 1000 grit to refine the cut and level the surface.

  • Finish with 1200 grit to prepare for polishing and clarity restoration.


4. Compound Machine Buffing

  • Apply headlight-safe compound using dual-action polisher or rotary tool.

  • Buff until sanding marks vanish and transparency returns.

  • Wipe clean to inspect lens finish.


5. Optional UV-Coating or Sealant

  • Apply headlight-specific sealant or UV-coating to protect restored lens from re-oxidation.

  • Allow proper cure time and buff to clean, dry-touch finish.


6. Final Clarity Check & Client Review

  • Inspect under light and angle for optical clarity.

  • Highlight visibility improvement and recommend reapplication cycle based on storage and exposure.

rows.intro: Clean above the line. Our Headliner Spot Cleaning service targets localized stains, smudges, and discoloration using low-moisture techniques that protect delicate overhead fabrics. Designed to refresh without oversaturation, this treatment removes buildup from isolated areas—reviving the headliner’s appearance while preserving its adhesive integrity and structural form.
rows.title: Headliner Spot Cleaning:
rows.overview:
1. Visual Inspection & Material Review

  • Examine headliner for sagging, separation, or surface staining.

  • Identify fabric type and adhesive strength to determine treatment safety.


2. Dusting & Debris Prep

  • Use compressed air or soft-bristle brush to lift dust, lint, and loose residue.

  • Prepare treatment zones with microfiber pre-wipe if necessary.


3. Spot Cleaning Application

  • Lightly mist low-moisture fabric cleaner onto microfiber or applicator—not directly onto headliner.

  • Gently dab and blot the stained area using a lift-and-pat technique (no rubbing).


4. Controlled Agitation (If Needed)

  • For stubborn buildup, use soft upholstery brush with feather-light agitation.

  • Avoid oversaturation or deep press that might disturb glue or foam layers.


5. Drying & Uniformity Check

  • Allow spot to air dry.

  • Inspect for watermarking, surface tension rings, or residue. Re-blend if needed.


6. Final Review & Client Education

  • Confirm improvement under natural lighting.

  • Offer care tips to prevent future contact stains and avoid harsh cleaners or oversaturation.

rows.intro: Contaminants gone. Clarity restored. Our Iron Deposit Decontamination service targets and removes embedded ferrous particles like brake dust, industrial fallout, and rail dust that bond to your vehicle’s paint, wheels, and trim. Using advanced pH-neutral iron removers, we safely dissolve these corrosive particles before they cause long-term damage—restoring a smooth, contaminant-free surface that’s ready for polishing or protection.
rows.title: Iron Deposit Decontamination:
rows.overview:
1. Visual Inspection & Particle Identification

  • Examine paintwork and wheels for signs of orange spotting, surface roughness, or discoloration.

  • Confirm presence of bonded iron contaminants across high-impact areas.


2. Wash & Prep Pass

  • Perform a full hand wash and rinse to remove loose grime, tar, and top-layer debris.

  • Dry or leave damp depending on product chemistry needs.


3. Iron Remover Application

  • Apply pH-neutral iron remover evenly to panels and wheel surfaces.

  • Allow product to react and bleed out contaminants (visible purple runoff).

  • Let dwell for manufacturer-specified time.


4. Agitation (If Needed)

  • Gently agitate stubborn areas using soft microfiber mitts or detailing brushes.

  • Avoid pressure or scrubbing on delicate surfaces.


5. Rinse & Inspection

  • Thoroughly rinse treated areas with clean water.

  • Reapply to any stubborn zones until clear of contamination.


6. Surface Drying & Post-Treatment Review

  • Dry panels and wheels completely.

  • Recommend clay bar decon or paint correction if surface is now smooth but still      visually flawed.

  • Prep vehicle for next-stage service (wax, sealant, coating).

rows.intro: Clean lines from top to tire. Our Running Boards, Side Skirts, Trim & Fender Wells Cleaning service targets areas that accumulate the most grime—and often get the least attention. Using high-quality cleaners and surface-safe tools, we eliminate buildup from these lower exterior components, restoring a crisp, polished finish that protects long-term integrity and sharpens your R.V.’s overall appearance.
rows.title: Exterior Trim & Fender Care:
rows.overview:
1. Component Inspection & Material Check

  • Examine running boards, skirt panels, fender wells, and lower trim for buildup, material type, and condition.

  • Identify oxidation, staining, or texture that may require specific cleaners or brushes.


2. Pre-Rinse & Contaminant Breakdown

  • Rinse targeted areas to remove loose dirt and debris.

  • Apply degreasers or bug removers to grime-heavy zones and allow dwell time for softening.


3. Scrubbing & Detailed Agitation

  • Use trim-safe brushes, foam tools, and mitts to dislodge buildup from textured surfaces and edges.

  • Address panel lips, step plates, and fender liners with dedicated tools for complete coverage.


4. Fender Well Flush & Deep Clean

  • Scrub inner fender wells and liners to lift accumulated mud, sand, and tar.

  • Rinse thoroughly to clear all product and dislodged material.


5. Drying & Finishing Pass

  • Dry components with microfiber towels or compressed air to prevent spotting or runoff.

  • Inspect for residue or streaking; re-clean areas if necessary.


6. Optional Trim Dressing or Conditioner

  • Apply trim or rubber conditioner to running boards and trim for UV protection and uniform finish.

  • Buff to a clean satin or gloss result, per client preference.
